about_the_game:
Pure Shinty Demo is an in development version of the full game Pure Shinty. This demo has some basic limited features but will give you an idea of whats to come and what to expect.

Demo Features

  • 5 teams to choose from

  • Basic 1v1 games, local co-op, singleplayer or Steam Remote Play Together

  • 5 minute game lengths - 2.5 minute halves.

  • Randomized player names and gear

  • Limited music playlist

Disclaimer

This is an in development build that will have bugs, but will have occasional updates as needed
